text:
Sofia: Hey team — FinServ Inc wants a 30-day POC. Requirements: streaming transcripts, function/tool calling to push into their ticketing system, and structured JSON output for downstream processing. They also asked about pricing and a security questionnaire. Demo Fri 10am. Can SE/SEC help coordinate? @Jamal

Jamal: Got it. I can own the demo + repo. Will need a short SDK streaming example + function call flow. Who's on security?

Priya: I can provision the demo infra. What's expected QPS and token sizes? Also need to know if hosted is acceptable vs private/vpc.

Sofia: Their initial numbers: steady ~50 req/s, avg 512 tokens, bursts to ~200/s. Prefer hosted with customer-managed KMS and audit logs if possible.

Nate: We support tool/function calling. Need to confirm sync vs async tool flow. For structured output we can enforce a JSON schema at generation-time. Quick streaming snippet (Node):
```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({
  model: 'rdi-1-stream',
  input: 'Process transcript and call ticket creation',
  functions: [{ name: 'create_ticket', parameters: { type: 'object' } }],
  stream: true
});
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta);
}
```

Mila-SEC: Security notes: we can provide SOC2 and ISO27001 docs. Hosted + KMS is acceptable but we will need IP allowlist and VPC peering for audit. I started the security pack and began the questionnaire.

Sofia: Pricing ask from the prospect: can we discount a POC? They want a simple number they can sign off on.

Jamal: Recommend $5k flat for 30 days (includes up to 2M tokens and 1 dev seat), plus an option: 20% discount on Dedicated commit if they convert within 60d. SEs: any objections?

Priya: Sounds fine. For the demo infra: I'll spin a hosted sandbox with audited logs and KMS enabled. Also running a synthetic workload replay to validate perf.

Nate: One potential engineering blocker: the streaming-optimized model variant has slightly different kernel qops and may not support some quantized paths used by older quantized models. It still meets latency targets (~30ms/token) for 50-200 qps but I'll run a baseline. Priya, can you run the workload sim against the harness?

Priya: Yup — I'll run the replay and upload results to the sales folder. ETA Thu EOD.

Sofia: :thumbsup: I'll update the buyer and lock Fri 10am. @Mila-SEC please add the security answers before then. Jamal, can you prep the demo repo with the snippets and a README?

Jamal: On it. I'll push a minimal demo repo with Node + Python streaming examples and a function-calling fixture. Sharing link shortly.

deploy-bot: Demo cluster provisioning for POC scheduled at 2024-06-20 03:00 UTC. Will notify when ready.

Mila-SEC: Added initial answers to the questionnaire and flagged 3 items needing legal review (data retention clauses).

Sofia: Thanks all. Action items: Jamal (demo repo), Priya (workload sim + infra), Mila (security pack), Nate (perf baseline). Let's sync Thu if any blockers.
